targetText: One is to combine the general with the particular; the other is to combine the leadership with the masses.
quote: One is to combine the general with the particular; the other is to combine the leadership with the masses.
summary: The two fundamental methods of Marxist leadership: combining general directives with concrete local investigation, and linking leadership with the initiative of the masses.

targetText: No one in a leading position is competent to give general guidance to all the units unless he derives concrete experience from particular individuals and events in particular subordinate units.
quote: No one in a leading position is competent to give general guidance to all the units unless he derives concrete experience from particular individuals and events in particular subordinate units.
summary: Bureaucracy vs concrete leadership: general guidance remains abstract and impotent without direct, concrete experience drawn from particular grassroots units.

targetText: However active the leading group may be, its activity will amount to fruitless effort by a handful of people unless combined with the activity of the masses. On the other hand, if the masses alone are active without a strong leading group to organize their activity properly, such activity cannot be sustained for long, or carried forward in the right direction, or raised to a high level.
quote: However active the leading group may be, its activity will amount to fruitless effort by a handful of people unless combined with the activity of the masses. On the other hand, if the masses alone are active without a strong leading group to organize their activity properly, such activity cannot be sustained for long, or carried forward in the right direction, or raised to a high level.
summary: Dialectics of leadership and mass action: neither vanguard isolation nor spontaneous, unorganized mass activity can sustain revolutionary advance.

targetText: In all the practical work of our Party, all correct leadership is necessarily "from the masses, to the masses". This means: take the ideas of the masses (scattered and unsystematic ideas) and concentrate them (through study turn them into concentrated and systematic ideas), then go to the masses and propagate and explain these ideas until the masses embrace them as their own, hold fast to them and translate them into action, and test the correctness of these ideas in such action.
quote: In all the practical work of our Party, all correct leadership is necessarily "from the masses, to the masses". This means: take the ideas of the masses (scattered and unsystematic ideas) and concentrate them (through study turn them into concentrated and systematic ideas), then go to the masses and propagate and explain these ideas until the masses embrace them as their own, hold fast to them and translate them into action, and test the correctness of these ideas in such action.
summary: The classic formulation of the mass line: concentrating the scattered experiences of the masses into systematic theory, then returning it to them to test and enrich in practice.

targetText: And so on, over and over again in an endless spiral, with the ideas becoming more correct, more vital and richer each time. Such is the Marxist theory of knowledge.
quote: And so on, over and over again in an endless spiral, with the ideas becoming more correct, more vital and richer each time. Such is the Marxist theory of knowledge.
summary: The Marxist theory of knowledge in political practice: an infinite spiral of synthesis and mass validation continuously raising revolutionary consciousness.
